investigation_notes.Description: Atypical volume of SharePoint downloads (550 files vs 120 baseline) was observed from the Engineering project repository from Tallinn at local time ~16:45 EET. The account belongs to a Senior Software Developer in Engineering and the sampled files are source code and supporting files, which aligns with a legitimate engineering backup or code sync activity; the user agent indicates a standard browser session rather than an automated tool. No recent related events or similar alerts were found, and the temporal and role-based context reduce the likelihood of malicious exfiltration, supporting a low priority classification.
